scripts.name: build
scripts.command: cross-env INIT_CWD=$PWD next build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-json-modules' node -r esbuild-register ./scripts/postbuild.mjs

scripts.name: lint
scripts.command: next lint --fix --dir pages --dir components --dir lib --dir layouts --dir scripts
